reviews.text: I have stubborn skin that doesn’t really react positively or negatively to skincare so it’s a bit tricky to rate products however I haven’t noticed any difference since using this. It absorbs super nicely and quick into the skin which I like, it’s worth trying but definitely not life changing for me
reviews.zh: 我塊皮膚屬於比較難搞嗰種，無論用咩護膚品都唔會有明顯好轉或者變差，所以要評價產品真係有啲難。不過自從用咗呢款之後，我真係完全感覺唔到有任何分別。佢吸收得好好又快，呢一點我幾鍾意。值得一試，但對我嚟講絕對唔係嗰種會改變人生嘅產品。

reviews.text:
Trong vô số những sản phẩm trị mụn trên thị trường hiện nay, việc tìm được một sản phẩm thật sự hiệu quả, lành tính và phù hợp với làn da không phải điều dễ dàng. Sau một thời gian dài trải nghiệm nhiều dòng mỹ phẩm khác nhau, mình quyết định thử một sản phẩm trị mụn chứa các hoạt chất nổi bật như Salicylic Acid, Niacinamide và Benzoyl Peroxide – những thành phần được đánh giá cao trong việc hỗ trợ điều trị mụn, giảm viêm và kiểm soát dầu nhờn. Sau hơn hai tháng sử dụng đều đặn, mình có khá nhiều cảm nhận tích cực về sản phẩm này và muốn chia sẻ lại một cách chân thực nhất.

Điều đầu tiên khiến mình ấn tượng chính là thiết kế bao bì. Sản phẩm có thiết kế tối giản nhưng hiện đại, cầm chắc tay và rất tiện mang theo. Kết cấu dạng gel mỏng nhẹ, thấm nhanh vào da và không gây bết dính. Đây là điểm mình cực kỳ thích vì da mụn thường rất dễ bí tắc nếu sử dụng sản phẩm quá đặc hoặc chứa nhiều dầu. Khi mới thoa lên da sẽ có cảm giác mát nhẹ, dễ chịu và không hề gây châm chích mạnh như n
reviews.zh:
而家市面上去暗瘡嘅產品多到數唔晒，要搵到一款真係有效、溫和又適合自己膚質嘅真係唔容易。我試過唔同牌子嘅護膚品試咗好耐，最後決定試一款主打去暗瘡、含幾種突出成分嘅產品，包括 Salicylic Acid、Niacinamide 同 Benzoyl Peroxide——呢啲成分喺幫助改善暗瘡、減少發炎、控制油脂分泌方面一向評價唔錯。我持續用咗兩個幾月，對呢款產品有唔少正面感受，想最真實地同大家分享。

最令我印象深刻嘅係包裝設計。產品走簡約風但有現代感，拎上手實在，方便攜帶。質地係輕薄嘅 gel 狀，好快就吸收曬入皮膚，唔會黐笠。呢一點我好喜歡，因為暗瘡肌如果用太厚或者含油量高嘅產品好容易堵塞毛孔。剛搽上面嘅時候有少少涼浸浸嘅感覺，舒服得嚟又唔會好似有啲產品咁有強烈嘅刺痛感

reviews.text:
It is calming and had helped my skin. It isn't very moisturizing, and my skin has been very dry lately so I'm looking to try something else maybe.
But thats just a personal preference though.

I really like what tea tree does for my skin, it calms down my redness so much, and I've bearly had any breakouts since getting this! 
I recommend this for oily sensitive skin type! 💚
reviews.zh:
佢有舒緩作用，亦都幫到我嘅皮膚。但保濕度唔算高，而我近排皮膚好乾，所以可能會想試吓其他嘢。
不過呢個只係個人喜好啫。

我真係好鍾意茶樹對我皮膚嘅效果，泛紅問題紓緩咗好多，自從用咗之後幾乎冇再爆瘡！
推薦畀油性敏感肌嘅朋友！💚

reviews.text: i think i’m obsessed with bringgreen. i find that they have a lot of products for acne prone skin which i’ve been struggling with for 6 years now. i have acne prone oily skin. i do find that my skin is also very dehydrated which is very difficult with oily skin. i recently stated using this product and used it while i was breaking out very badly. it was one of those under the skin pimples which are very painful. i found this very calming to the skin. it really saved me with that breakout. my skin is very sensitive but i had no problems with stinging or even worst breakouts after using this product. the scent is a slight tea tree scent. this is on the thicker side and it is a bit sticky(?) so i prefer using this at night. i have used it under makeup and it doesn’t feel very thick. wish i would’ve purchased the bigger bottle but HIGHLY recommend the smaller bottle for a first purchase to test it out. PLEASE do test it first on your skin to make sure it’s fit for your face!
reviews.zh: 我覺得我對 bringgreen 已經上咗癮。佢哋有好多針對暗瘡肌嘅產品，而我同暗瘡博鬥咗足足 6 年。我係油性肌但容易生暗瘡，而且皮膚好缺水，對油性肌嚟講真係好難搞。我最近開始用呢款產品，當時正值暗瘡大爆發，啲瘡全部都生喺皮膚入面，掂到就痛。我覺得佢對皮膚有好好嘅舒緩作用，真係救咗我嗰次爆瘡。我皮膚好敏感，但用完之後完全冇出現刺痛或者暗瘡惡化嘅情況。氣味方面有少少茶樹味。質地偏向厚身，而且有少少黐（？），所以我比較鍾意夜晚用。我試過搽完再上妝，又唔覺得好厚。早知就買大樽嘅，但第一次買嘅話我極度推薦先買細樽試吓。拜託一定要先試喺皮膚上面，確保啱自己塊面先用！

reviews.text: Very nice calming, non exfoliating serum for acne. It calms skin and slows oil production. It’s not very hydrating so I like to pair it with other hydrating serums. You definitely have to use it regularly to see results. I feel like it’s a little too gentle for my stubborn cystic acne, so I don’t see immediate results. I like to use it on days where I want to treat my acne without using exfoliating ingredients.
reviews.zh: 好正嘅舒緩型抗暗瘡精華，唔含去角質成分。佢可以令皮膚平靜落嚟，減慢油脂分泌。不過保濕力唔算好強，所以我會配搭其他保濕精華一齊用。要持續用先會見到效果。我覺得對我嗰啲好難搞嘅囊腫型暗瘡嚟講，佢稍為溫柔咗啲，所以唔會即時見效。我鍾意喺想處理暗瘡但又唔想用去角質成分嗰日用佢。

reviews.text:
I’ve been using the BRINGGREEN Zinc Teca 1.2% Blemish Serum for a few weeks now, and it’s quickly become a staple in my skincare routine. The formula feels lightweight and absorbs easily into the skin without leaving any sticky residue, which makes it perfect for both morning and evening use.

What really stands out is how calming it is. Whenever I have active breakouts or redness, this serum noticeably soothes my skin and helps reduce irritation. The combination of zinc and centella (Teca) seems to work well in keeping blemishes under control while supporting skin healing at the same time.

I also appreciate that it doesn’t dry out my skin like some other acne treatments. Instead, it keeps my skin balanced—less oily in problem areas, but still hydrated overall. Over time, I’ve noticed fewer breakouts and a smoother, more even complexion.

The packaging is simple and hygienic, and a little goes a long way, so the 25mL bottle lasts longer than expected.

reviews.zh:
我用 BRINGGREEN Zinc Teca 1.2% Blemish Serum 已經幾個星期，佢好快就成為我護膚程序入面嘅必備品。質地輕盈，好容易就吸收曬入皮膚，完全唔會留低黐笠嘅感覺，所以日頭同夜晚用都一樣啱。

最突出嘅係佢嘅舒緩效果。每當我有活躍嘅暗瘡或者泛紅，呢枝精華都好明顯咁令皮膚得到紓緩，幫助減少刺激。Zinc 同 centella（Teca）嘅組合似乎可以好好咁控制瑕疵，同時支援皮膚修復。

我亦都好欣賞佢唔會好似其他暗瘡療程咁令皮膚變乾。相反，佢可以令皮膚保持平衡——容易出油嘅位置冇咁油，但整體仍然夠水潤。用咗一段時間之後，我發覺暗瘡少咗，膚質亦都變得更加平滑均勻。

包裝簡潔又衛生，而且好少份量已經夠用，所以 25mL 嘅樽比預期中更加襟用。

整體嚟講，我會好推薦

reviews.text: This spring my skin barrier suddenly became sensitive, out of nowhere getting random irritation small bumps and redness. This serum helped so much to sooth my skin. 2 weeks spot treatment on the repatedly appearing small dots (along woth very gentle care) and my skin is back to normal. It was sensitive enough in the reactive phase of my skin. 5 stars!
reviews.zh: 今個春天我嘅肌膚屏障突然變得敏感，莫名其妙出現各種刺激、細小粒粒同泛紅。呢支精華大大幫到我舒緩肌膚。對住反覆出現嘅細小斑點做咗兩星期重點修護（配合非常溫和嘅護理），皮膚已經回復正常。喺我肌膚嘅反應期當中，佢都夠晒溫和。五星！

reviews.text: I LOVE THIS SERUM. Ive struggled with acne since I turned 13 years old, I am now 21. This has calmed my acne like no other. I have used the skin1004 Madagascar serum and it calms pretty well overnight but this brightgreen serum has worked wonders on my skin. The photos attached are 2 weeks apart. My acne is so much flatter, more managed, and less red. My acne scars heal into red spots and I have noticed them going away. I have also noticed that im getting less pimples and if I do have a breakout, my pimples are gone sooo quickly without a trace left behind. I do have the Purito Bamboo Panthenol Cream to thank for my skin texture and my pores looking better in the photos. But my acne and acne scars have healed soo much in 2 weeks. It has now been 1 month and I am almost out of this serum. I am waiting for a restock and then imma buy the bigger size of this serum. Its now a staple in my skincare.
reviews.zh: 我超愛呢支精華！我由13歲開始就一直受暗瘡困擾，而家已經21歲。佢鎮靜暗瘡嘅效果係我試過入面最好。我用過 skin1004 馬達加斯加精華，雖然過夜鎮靜效果都唔錯，但呢支 brightgreen 精華喺我皮膚上簡直係奇蹟。附上嘅相相隔兩星期。我嘅暗瘡平坦咗好多，狀態受控咗，紅腫都減退咗。我嘅暗瘡印會變成紅斑，我留意到佢哋逐漸消退。我亦留意到生痘痘嘅次數減少咗，就算真係爆瘡，痘痘都好快消失得乾乾淨淨，唔留痕跡。皮膚質地同毛孔喺相入面睇落好咗好多，呢點要歸功於 Purito Bamboo Panthenol Cream。但我嘅暗瘡同暗瘡印喺兩星期內已經好咗好多。宜家已經用咗一個月，精華就快見底。我等緊補貨，之後會買大支裝嘅呢支精華。佢已經成為我護膚程序中嘅必需品。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
